updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports monitoring and enforcing policies on sensitive data transferred via FTP and SFTP protocols. Organizations can configure transfer activities in their DLP policies to block or restrict policy-violating data movement over these protocols, extending data protection beyond cloud-native channels.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A certificate validation weakness in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass security features over the network. Admins managing PKI infrastructure should apply the available security updates to prevent unauthorized certificate issuance or trust violations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in Active Directory Domain Services that could allow an attacker with network access to gain higher privileges within the directory. Organizations should prioritize patching domain controllers to prevent unauthorized access escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial of service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos could allow an attacker to disrupt authentication services. Identity admins should apply updates to prevent service disruptions that could impact user sign-in and access to on-premises resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: An NTLM spoofing vulnerability affects Windows including Office software, allowing an attacker to impersonate legitimate users in authentication scenarios. Admins should update affected systems to prevent credential spoofing attacks, particularly in hybrid identity environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Extends Protection to Local AI Agents
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now protects sensitive data across AI agent interactions, including prompts, files, and tool interactions with local agents. Organizations can enforce DLP policies at agent-to-human and agent-to-tool interaction points, mitigating data exposure risks as AI systems access enterprise information.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Extends to Network Layer via Azure Firewall
updates.summary: DLP capabilities now integrate with Azure Firewall to detect and protect sensitive data in network traffic, including text, files, and AI interactions from servers, VMs, and automated workloads. This network-layer protection helps prevent unauthorized data sharing through browsers, applications, and APIs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels Now Support Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends classification and governance controls to Entra security groups without requiring separate label configuration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Now Evaluates Recipient and Site Owner Lifecycle Status
updates.summary: Adaptive Scopes now provide explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, allowing administrators to ensure policy targeting aligns with current organizational membership and status. This improves precision in policy application across dynamic populations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Extends to Non-Microsoft Cloud Applications
updates.summary: DLP and information protection auto-labeling now support non-Microsoft SaaS platforms including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This allows organizations to enforce consistent data protection policies across their entire cloud application ecosystem.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Introduces Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows analysts with appropriate permissions to classify alerts as True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive with predefined classification reasons. This replaces the previous dismissal system and helps organizations better tune alerts and improve risk reporting accuracy.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: SharePoint document libraries can now automatically label existing files to match the default sensitivity label configured on the library. This addresses labeling gaps for static content and ensures consistent security without relying on manual user actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels Inherit from Teams Meetings to Artifacts
updates.summary: Teams meeting artifacts including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes can now automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting itself. This reduces manual labeling burden and ensures consistent protection for content generated during meetings.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Improved Sensitive Information Types for More Accurate Detection
updates.summary: Microsoft enhanced its out-of-the-box sensitive information types to detect sensitive data with greater precision and reliability. This improves DLP policy effectiveness and reduces false positives in data classification workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Recurring Classifier Refresh Keeps Classifications Current
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is evolving its On-Demand Classification feature to support recurring refresh cycles that automatically update content classifications as data and business context change. This reduces manual reclassification overhead and maintains accurate classification over time.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent Enables Sensitive Data Remediation
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent integrated with Microsoft Teams now offers automated remediation of sensitive data such as SSNs, passwords, and credit card numbers across thousands of SharePoint and OneDrive files. This proactive capability significantly increases the percentage of remediated sensitive data and reduces compliance risk.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import Enables Direct Mailbox Migration
updates.summary: Organizations can now import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the Exchange Migration Service pattern. This two-step process includes analysis and execution phases, streamlining mailbox migration workflows for hybrid scenarios.
